components.name: Secondary Button

narrative.overview: LawGPT AI reads as a premium digital workspace where trusted legal counsel meets modern AI, not a generic AI-startup dashboard. The system pulls from paper, ink, and brass: the physical materials of a lawyer's desk, translated into software with restraint. Typography carries authority (a serif display face used sparingly for headlines), while the working surface stays quiet, warm-neutral paper, near-black ink text, a single deep-forest accent for action, a brass highlight reserved for rare emphasis. This system explicitly rejects the generic AI-startup toolkit: no gradient blobs, no glassmorphism, no neon or purple-blue 'AI' accent colors, no floating glowing cards, no hero-metric templates with gradient text.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper background, never stark white or cold gray
One accent (forest green) carries almost all action color; brass is a rare highlight, not a second primary
Serif display type for authority, sans body for readability, mono for anything record-like
Flat surfaces at rest; elevation is a response to interaction, not a permanent decoration
Motion is restrained and purposeful: entrances fade/slide once, nothing loops or glows

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Forest green is the only color that means 'action' anywhere in the product.

rules.name: The Brass Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Brass appears at most once per screen, marking the single most important verified/emphasized element.

rules.name: The Serif Restraint Rule
rules.body: Source Serif 4 appears only at h1-h3 scale, never in body copy, buttons, or labels.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing above resting card shadow unless a user is actively hovering or focusing it.

dos: Do keep the page background warm paper (#F9F8F6), never stark white or cold gray.
Do use Counsel Forest as the only action/accent color; let brass appear at most once per screen.
Do use Source Serif 4 only at heading scale (h1-h3); everything else is Inter or IBM Plex Mono.
Do keep shadows flat at rest; only add card-hover in response to actual hover/focus interaction.
Do use IBM Plex Mono for stats, case numbers, and timestamps so records read as precise, not decorative.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion for any new motion.
donts: Don't use gradient blobs, glassmorphism, or blue/purple 'AI startup' accent colors.
Don't build hero-metric templates (big number, small label, gradient accent) as the default hero shape.
Don't add tiny uppercase tracked eyebrows above every section, or numbered 01/02/03 scaffolding unless the content is a real, ordered sequence.
Don't use border-left/border-right colored stripes as a card or callout accent.
Don't let anything float permanently: no persistent shadow, glow, or 'lifted' card at rest.
Don't introduce a second saturated accent color alongside Counsel Forest.
